title: Local recognition of the odd geometric outer columns
statement: The outer-column recognition statement of lem-pc-perfect-hom-mayer-vietoris-geometric-columns restricted to indices 1 and 4.

proof.text: X is quasi-separated over its affine base, so the compact opens U and V have compact intersection W. Since W lies in U union V, W is contained in the image of t. Apply the single-open stage presentation with n = -1 and n = 0 to obtain the stage and apex equivalences for this intersection.

The odd row objects are ULift of Hom into the shifted intersection direct image, and map_hom₃ gives their transition and cocone components. Compose the stage/apex equivalences with ULift.down to identify the actual row systems and their specified transport equations.

Use the underlying canonical group-colimit cocone as a set-colimit cocone. The tail is nonempty and directed; Mathlib AddCommGrpCat.FilteredColimits.forget_preservesFilteredColimits, preservesFilteredColimitsOfSize_shrink and isColimitOfPreserves give its universal property. The identity source equivalence and the apex equivalence satisfy the defining pinning equation by colimit.ι_desc. Hence each column is a basic local comparison on W = U intersection V. Equality of Fin values treats exactly columns 1 and 4.

theorem perfect_hom_mayerVietoris_geometric_columns_odd
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R)
    (i : I) (X : Scheme.{u}) (s₀ : X ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s₀] [QuasiCompact s₀] [QuasiSeparated s₀]
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    (U V : X.Opens) (hU : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (hV : IsAffineOpen V)
    (Y : Scheme.{u}) (t : Y ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion t]
    (ht : t.opensRange = U ⊔ V)
    (s : Y ⟶ Spec (R.obj i)) (hs : s = t ≫ s₀)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation s] [QuasiCompact s] [QuasiSeparated s]
    [∀ W : Y.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace).over W))]
    (P Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (hP : Y.IsPerfect P) (hQ : Y.IsPerfect Q)
    (F : Set.Ici i ⥤ schemeDerivedCategory Y) (d : Cocone F)
    (h : PerfectHomPushPullData R c s Q F d)
    (A : PerfectHomMVFamily Y (t ⁻¹ᵁ U) (t ⁻¹ᵁ V)) :
    ∀ (r : Fin 5), r.val = 1 ∨ r.val = 4 →
      PerfectHomLocalMap R c i X s₀ U V
        (colimit.desc
          ((A.diagram F h.stageQCoh ⋙ perfectHomTriangleRowFunctor Y P).flip.obj r)
          ⟨(perfectHomTriangleRow Y P (A.cocone F d h.stageQCoh h.limitQCoh).pt).obj r,
            (perfectHomTriangleRowCoconeMap Y P (A.diagram F h.stageQCoh)
              (A.cocone F d h.stageQCoh h.limitQCoh)).app r⟩)
